parent.notes: Fixes the empty HTTPS server address on the login screen. The app now starts with the project server address pre-filled (the same address the child app documents), also after an update or a fresh install. The field stays editable and a saved address still wins. Login, billing and all other features are unchanged. Signed ARM + ARM64 APK after successful static analysis and tests. No phone testing claimed.

client.notes: Adds 32-bit ARM support. Previous APKs lacked the 32-bit Flutter engine and app library; this may explain launch failure on 32-bit Android. All features are unchanged from v24 (source diff: build and version files only). Retest pending on a 32-bit phone. Signed ARM + ARM64 + x86-64 APK after successful static analysis and tests. Not tested on a physical phone.
